giver: Bounty office: weaponsmiths in every village (pooled representatives) and the Bountiful bounty boards; in Reece, Bounty Master Corvin Ash, a scarred old monster hunter.
feel: Monster hunter's contracts: wanted posters, dungeons cleared for coin, an arena ladder, a dead hunter's unfinished work, and ever-nastier named targets.

quests.title: Wanted
quests.summary: Corvin Ash in Reece tells you the office posts its work on bounty boards; find a board in a village and take your first contract from it.

quests.title: Drills on the Dummy
quests.summary: No hunter goes out untrained: craft a target dummy and land a full Better Combat combo, then deal a set amount of damage to it inside a minute.
quests.reward: Attack XP, a whetstone's worth of iron

quests.title: Night Shift
quests.summary: The first proper contract: a village's outskirts crawl with zombies of every odd variety; put down fifteen in one night.

quests.title: The Thief in the Mine
quests.summary: A bounty on a 'thief' who robs miners turns out to be a rascal playing hide-and-seek in a mineshaft; find it three times and it pays you off with what it stole.
quests.reward: Attack XP, the rascal's stolen loot

quests.title: Weapon of Choice
quests.summary: Ash makes you choose your style: forge an iron Spartan weapon (longsword, katana, rapier, glaive or warhammer) and wear it on your back or hip like a hunter.

quests.title: The Unfinished Contract
quests.summary: You find the remains of a fallen adventurer, a bounty hunter with a contract still clutched in their bones. Read it and finish their job.
quests.reward: Attack XP, the dead hunter's journal

quests.title: Clearing the Cellar
quests.summary: The journal points to a dungeon below a village; clear a YUNG's dungeon and break its spawners.

quests.title: Silk and Venom
quests.summary: A spider dungeon has been sending its brood into the fields; clear it and cut the poison sac from its biggest spider as proof.

quests.title: Graveyard Shift
quests.summary: The dead won't stay down in an old graveyard; spend a night there and put fifteen undead back in the ground.

quests.title: The Mauler
quests.summary: A beast-tamer's bounty: a mauler, small, fast and all teeth, has been savaging travellers in the badlands. Find it, survive its rush, and the tamer's feral claws are your pay.

quests.title: Bandit Country
quests.summary: An uncommon bounty: illager bandits have built towers over a trade road. Take them down and bring back their banner.
quests.reward: Attack XP, an uncommon bounty reward

quests.title: Wanted: the Skelewag
quests.summary: Sailors want a skelewag dead, a skeletal pirate fish that rams boats over shipwrecks; hunt it in the water and bring back its sword.

quests.title: Witch Hunt
quests.summary: A village blames a witch for its sick cattle; track her to her swamp hut, defeat her and bring back her hat as proof.

quests.title: The Arena Ladder
quests.summary: An arena's master runs a ladder: win three fights in a row against rising waves without leaving the sand. The champion's power glove goes to whoever finishes.

quests.title: Knock Them Down
quests.summary: Something nests high in an aviary, swooping on anyone below. Climb up and clear it, the quick way: knock its occupants off the edge. A piston-spring trinket waits at the top.

quests.title: Master of Arms
quests.summary: Ash says a hunter should master more than one weapon: make kills with a halberd, a rapier, a warhammer and a throwing weapon.
quests.reward: Attack XP, a diamond weapon of choice

quests.title: The Hunter's Trail
quests.summary: The dead hunter's journal names three more of their old haunts; find other fallen adventurers on the trail and piece together who they were hunting.
quests.reward: Attack XP, a hunter's compass page

quests.title: Epic Contract: the Fortress
quests.summary: An epic bounty from the board: wither skeletons have overrun a Nether fortress; kill twenty and bring back three skulls for the office.
quests.reward: Attack XP, an epic bounty reward

quests.title: Brute Force
quests.summary: Piglin brutes guard a bastion's treasure room; a rare bounty wants five of them dead, without golden armour to hide behind.
quests.reward: Attack XP, a rare bounty reward

quests.title: The Burning Revenant
quests.summary: A fire-wreathed revenant guards the soul blacksmith's forge in the Nether. Defeat the ignited revenant and take the smith's fire gauntlet that it was protecting.

quests.title: The Pale Count
quests.summary: The trail ends at an undead crypt: the dead hunter was after a vampire noble. Go in at night, defeat the Pale Count, and take the hunter's own glove from the crypt, which drinks life from every blow.

quests.title: Laid to Rest
quests.summary: Bring the dead hunter's journal back to Corvin Ash; he knew them, and finally tells you why he stopped hunting.

quests.title: Champion of the Coliseum
quests.summary: The great coliseum holds the hardest ladder of all; fight to the top with netherite and a Spartan weapon you've mastered.
quests.reward: Attack XP, a netherite weapon of choice

quests.title: The Plague Asylum
quests.summary: Nobody who goes into the plague asylum comes out; a legendary bounty is posted on whatever lives there. Clear it.
quests.reward: Attack XP, a legendary bounty reward

quests.title: Contract in the Void
quests.summary: Even the End gets bounties: clear an End city's towers of shulkers and endermen for a client who won't give their name.

quests.title: The Cursed Contracts
quests.summary: Three wanted posters in Ash's own hand: the Prowler in the Ancient Factory, the Ender Golem at the Ruined Citadel and the Coralssus in the Sunken City.
quests.reward: Attack XP, Witherite and coral chunks

quests.title: Draugr Season
quests.summary: The Frosted Prison's draugr walk the snows; hunt a royal draugr and bring back its crown as proof.

quests.title: The Last Contract
quests.summary: With every poster in the office torn down, Ash gives you the last one: his own name, retired. He hands over his blade and the office with it.
quests.reward: Attack XP, Ash's Verdict (netherite longsword: Sharpness V, Looting III, Unbreaking III, Mending)
